root_cause_hypothesis: The dual-write writer gaps from the 2026-07-29 draft capture are fixed and verified: AxTable now emits AllowRowVersionChangeTracking (create writer, byte-identical to the golden incl. property order) and AxDataEntityView now emits it too, so the whole case is reachable through the grounded tool path with NO hand-authored XML (table = create + modify/add-index; entity = create with standardStructure:true; privilege = create). The single residual golden diff is buildAxDataEntityXml() in src/tools/dataEntityXml.ts emitting <DataManagementEnabled>No</DataManagementEnabled> + <DataManagementStagingTable /> UNCONDITIONALLY (dataManagementEnabled === true is the only branch; false and undefined both write the 'No' block). Census on the real AOT: 0 of 3236 ApplicationSuite/Foundation AxDataEntityView files carry either element in its default form, 2890 carry DataManagementEnabled=Yes; and a bridge round-trip (IMetadataProvider.Update) DROPS both, which proves the platform serializer treats them as omitted defaults - exactly as the same function already reasons about IsPublic. Semantically harmless (build 0 errors, BP 0 errors) but it is a real one-element mismatch, so golden_pending stays true. SECOND, INDEPENDENT DEFECT found this run: modify-property EntityCategory=Master on a data-entity reports "applied via IMetadataProvider.Update()" but the value is UNREPRESENTABLE through the bridge - Master is the enum default, so the serializer omits it and the element vanishes from the file the tool just claimed to update. The case pins EntityCategory=Master explicitly, so only the file-writer (create) path can satisfy it. THIRD: d365fo_file(action="generate", objectType="table") - the documented Azure/Linux fallback - runs a different, stub generator (XmlTemplateGenerator.generateAxTableXml in src/tools/generateD365Xml.ts) that hard-codes <Fields /> and <Indexes /> and silently ignores properties.fields, cacheLookup, replacementKey, primaryIndex, configurationKey and tableType, and omits <FullTextIndexes/>/<Mappings/>/<StateMachines/>. On Azure/Linux this produces a FIELDLESS table from the same arguments that produce the golden on Windows. FOURTH: entity-writer properties standardStructure / declaration / methods / fieldGroups / publicEntityName / publicCollectionName / label are absent from the data-entity line of the d365fo_file tool schema, so the grounded agent cannot discover standardStructure - without it create omits SourceCode, FieldGroups, DeleteActions and StateMachines (present in 5859/5859 shipped entities). FIFTH (validator): validate_code(mode="references", codeType="xml-any") accepted structurally INVALID XML (a </Fields> closing a <DataSources> block) without complaint and verified only 1 reference in an AxDataEntityView that names a table, two data fields and a label. SIXTH (index hygiene): prepare(mode="create") reported collisions for both ConDemoSyncCustomer and ConDemoSyncCustomerEntity although neither existed on disk - a previous run's rollback deleted the files but left the symbol-index rows, so every re-run of a case starts with a false collision warning. Measurement integrity: the green build is real - force+fullBuild, log and Contoso/bin/*.md both rewritten at 07:36:02 (baseline 2026-07-29 19:09:47), and a negative probe (table AllowRowVersionChangeTracking removed) flipped the same full build to Errors: 1 with the cross-object metadata error, proving the entity property is genuinely deserialized. BP was proven to run: '1 elements processed.' in all three per-element checks (entity 0/0, table 2 warnings, privilege 1 warning; 0 BP errors overall = the case's own gate). Runtime metadata Contoso_AxDataEntityView.md confirms EntityKey over CustomerCode, not RecId.
suggested_fix_area: src/tools/dataEntityXml.ts buildAxDataEntityXml (emit the DataManagement block only when dataManagementEnabled is truthy, mirroring the existing IsPublic omission); src/tools/modifyD365File.ts modify-property (warn when the requested value equals the metamodel default and will therefore not survive serialization, instead of reporting success); src/tools/generateD365Xml.ts generateAxTableXml (delegate to the create-path builder in src/tools/createD365File.ts XmlTemplateGenerator.generateAxTableXml so the Azure/Linux fallback is not lossy); src/server/toolSchemas/d365foFile.ts data-entity property line (document standardStructure + publicEntityName/publicCollectionName/label); src/tools/validateCode.ts xml-any reference resolver (well-formedness check + AxDataEntityView ref coverage); symbol-index deletion hygiene on rollback.
